name: bd-divisions-to-unions
description: A comprehensive npm package providing complete Bangladesh administrative hierarchy data — Divisions, Districts, Upazilas, and Unions — in both Bangla and English.

scripts.test: node -e "const pkg = require('./index.js'); const d = pkg.getAllDivision(); if(!d || !d.length) process.exit(1); console.log('✓ getAllDivision (bn):', d.length, 'divisions'); const de = pkg.getAllDivision('en'); console.log('✓ getAllDivision (en):', de.length, 'divisions'); const dist = pkg.getDistricts(d[0].value); console.log('✓ getDistricts:', dist && dist.length, 'districts'); console.log('All checks passed!');"
